capabilities.title: Fatigue and durability
capabilities.description: Investigate behaviour under repeated loading, characterise fatigue response and compare life predictions with experimental results.

capabilities.title: Mechanical characterisation
capabilities.description: Study the mechanical response of engineering materials and components. Previous research includes polymer composites, hybrid joints and the influence of temperature on material behaviour.

capabilities.title: Joints and structural integrity
capabilities.description: Connect measurements and computational analysis to assess welded components and mechanical joints, including residual stresses and fatigue response.

capabilities.title: Numerical–experimental validation
capabilities.description: Combine finite element analysis with mechanical measurements to examine model predictions. Research experience includes strain, vibration and temperature measurements and component-level correlation.

capabilities.title: Engineering data and methods
capabilities.description: Process experimental data, develop scientific software and compare analytical or computational methods. Reproducible datasets and documented algorithms support interpretation and model validation.

measurement_context.title: Material and joint response
measurement_context.description: Previous studies document static and fatigue characterisation of materials and joints. The specimen, loading conditions and required measurements define the feasibility of a new campaign.

measurement_context.title: Strain, vibration and temperature
measurement_context.description: These measurement categories feature in existing research. Sensors, acquisition settings, operating ranges and facility access must be confirmed for each investigation.

measurement_context.title: Model correlation and data processing
measurement_context.description: Experimental results can be compared with finite element and analytical models, using scientific programming to evaluate predictions and document the analysis.

equipment.title: Structural vibration and dynamics
equipment.description: Shaker-based experimental setups for vibration measurements, dynamic characterisation and vibration-fatigue investigations. Related research also includes laser-vibrometer modal measurements.

equipment.title: Thermal and environmental conditioning
equipment.description: Equipment for temperature-controlled fatigue, creep and creep–fatigue testing, including induction and resistance ovens and a StepLab climatic chamber.

equipment.title: Specimen preparation and metrology
equipment.description: CNC turning, milling and tooling for round, flat, notched and tubular specimens. Surface characterisation includes contact and optical roughness measurements and Vickers hardness tests.

equipment.description: High-speed infrared camera for non-contact temperature-field measurements during experimental investigations.
